newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble steady in calm client trade.
newsitem.headline: Rouble steady in calm client trade.

text.p: The rouble was steady in calm trading ahead of the weekend, with banks mainly fulfilling their client orders, dealers said on Friday.
roubles/dollar May 16 midday May 16 early May 15 close
"Client orders dominated today's market and client (dollar) selling was somehow equal to buying," Moscow Business World Bank dealer Nikolai Zolotaryov said.
United Investment Bank chief dealer Alexander Suchkov said: "The day has been calm, as usual on Fridays. Fluctuations were scarce as investing in dollars is not very attractive despite low roubles."

Cheap rouble credits could be due to funds coming back from Russia's regions after commercial banks had earlier sent roubles to their clients outside Moscow for such payments as wages and pensions, dealers said.
"It all happens in cycles, roubles leave Moscow but return eventually from other regions," one said.
